name: tpl-precedence-4-goal
task: Reach the exit, but you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The Existence(at_exit) clause repeats what the other two clauses already force. RespondedExistence(switch_toggled, at_exit) already requires at_exit at least once, and Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) with it also forces the exit. Additionally, the normalized wording of the RespondedExistence clause misstates the rule: the task's 'if the switch is flipped first, then reach the exit' is covered by Existence and Precedence; the RespondedExistence adds nothing beyond these. Remove the redundant Existence(at_exit) clause; keep Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) hard, which alone with the RespondedExistence forces the exit.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires the exit, and hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) enforces that the switch was toggled first. Together the two clauses capture the task.

texts: The agent must reach the exit at least once.
The agent must flip the switch before reaching the exit.
